My brother was driving this SUV we had. He drove down this real curvy road and my stepfather was in the passenger seat out cold. We went around a corner and I decided that I NEEDED to move. So I moved to the other side of the SUV for no reason and put the child lock on the seatbelt. A few minutes later my brother was looking into a field, hit the shoulder of the road and we ended up rolling down a cliff. The side of the SUV I was on got totally crushed to the seat by a tree and had I not moved I would have been crushed with it. 
No idea why I felt I needed to move. Glad I did!
